out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the cashier being used to rinse frother pitcher and milk frother.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands.CFM instructed employee to use handsink just for handwashing.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Observed liquid egg on top of bagels and lettuce in unit # 1, and raw salmon on top of RTE ham sandwiches
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM relocated liquid eggs to the bottom shelf, salmon to the left side with the raw shell eggs and discarded 4 sandwiches that were in direct contact with the raw salmon.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the chlorine-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the sanitizer bucket at font with a concentration of 0 ppm total chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: A chlorine-based sanitizing solution shall have a minimum concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine when tested using the appropriate test kit. CFM prepared a new sanitizer bucket at 150 ppm to store wiping clothes

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: Observed ice machine soiled on the left wall
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized.CFM sanitized the wall and will clean and sanitize the whole ice machine at the end of the day. Grounded Coffee (Inspection Date: 06/16/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed Frosting with cream cheese at 68F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded Frosting with cream cheese

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed a wet wiping cloth to clean the espresso wand stored on the espresso machine
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.CFM prepared a sanitizer bucket and stored wiping cloth.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use. Observed mop stored in the mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. CFM hang the mop in the mop rack.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM was able to locate the v/d policy on the website and printed it for compliance.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: the carafes on the counter with cream and the TCS pastry display case uses time as a public health control. The facility has the written procedures but the food was not marked with the 4 hour end point.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM labeled the food in the display case and the cream carafes with the appropriate time parameters for proper discard.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The hand sink near the 3 compartment sink is not in operation due to the pipes leaking
violations.corrective_action: The CFM will need to obtain repairs for the hand sink and provide proof of the repairs to the EHS for review.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed Cream cheese, unsalted butter, Babybel Edam cheese in unit # 6at 48, 48, 47F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded Cream cheese, unsalted butter, Babybel Edam cheese from unit # 6

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 6-service area display cooler at 46F
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Adjust/repair the unit and do not use to store TCS ( perishables) foods

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the handsink near 3-compartment sink piping are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.
